name: Coordinate System and Axis Swapping
definition: The tool assumes an input OFF file coordinate system where x=right, y=up, z=forward. During voxelization, the x and y axes are swapped so that the output volume's first dimension corresponds to height (Y-axis).
summary: Coordinate System and Axis Swapping converts right-handed mesh data into voxel grids by swapping x and y axes during voxelization, differing from general conversion by performing this specific swap rather than post-hoc metadata adjustment.
